text: Illustrate the story here: Five Mile Hike Chan rides his skates to the lake. When Chan gets to the lake, he looks for his pal Eve. He sees Eve on the black dock. "Want to hike?" asks Eve. "Yep!" Chan says. "OK. Grab these snacks for us to have on the hike," says Eve. Eve and Chan hike for a long time. "This is a long hike!" says Chan. "Yes. It is five miles" says Eve. Eve and Chan talk as they walk. Eve tells Chan when they are close to the top. "Here we are! The top of the hill!" Eve yells. Eve and Chan can see for miles. "Thank you for this grand hike," says Chan with a wide smile.
